title: Community Service and Problem Solving
prompt: In many cities, local communities face persistent problems such as littering, noise, or unsafe public spaces. Some people believe that residents should take an active role in solving these problems through community service, while others think it is the responsibility of local authorities. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. In your essay, explain what kinds of community service might be effective and what challenges such initiatives could face. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类写作任务，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请仔细阅读题目，确保在作文中讨论双方观点并给出自己的立场，同时分析社区服务的有效形式及可能面临的挑战。建议先规划文章结构，再动笔写作，字数不少于250词。
